Description.Name: Fuel Cell
Description.Details: Fuel cell engines are primarily used in civilian applications like rail systems, personal transport, and IndustrialMechs. These engines generate electrical power by combining two suitable reactants (a fuel and an oxidizer) in a controlled pair of redox reactions, providing power to operate the vehicle's propulsion and other electrical systems. A fuel cell engine has several advantages over the typical internal combustion engine. A fuel cell system is usually about 40% lighter than a comparable internal combustion engine.
